# agent-trajectory-eval

> Evaluate recorded agent trajectories against expectations: tool sequence modes, forbidden tools, step budgets, repeated calls, argument and final-answer checks Python package `trysac-agent-trajectory-eval`, import name `agent_trajectory_eval`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
